verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each element of the story. You enable Amend in the commit dialog to change the latest commit. Unpushed commits can be undone by swiping, which leaves their changes as modified files. Hunk-level staging then lets you re-commit those changes split into separate commits, and long-tap actions add squash, delete and edit-message rewrites. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the amend/undo workflow.
